what: The watchdog's events job_stalled (a running job without progress for the work style's stall_min minutes) and branch_stranded (a task's branch without a merge, no open job, 3 days) get one hint: report progress or end the job, merge the branch or park the task with set_delivery; never restart or delete on its own. agent_job.py start passes the chain to Kalmido: --parent as parent_id, --continue-of as continue_of, several --task as task_ids (status prints them)
